title: Wanderer's Satchel
description: A GM hub for your other modules: one window with an overview and a page per module (installed version, active, update available, last health check), buttons that open each module's own control panel, health check, docs and issue page, a combined health check, one-file settings export and import for all of them, and one Debug logging switch. Every module stays standalone; other modules can join through a small registration API. Works with any game system.
